spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Ordered Cycle of All Knowledges

---

**¶1:** The ordered cycle of all knowledges of good and truth is a great and mighty spiritual reality. It is one among the four fundamental domains of the mind, for the whole of dominion over spiritual states is distributed among four parts.

**¶2:** The first domain is the spiritual forces that dwell within the ten ascending degrees of heavenly consciousness that exist above the cycle of knowledges, and the power of evil that is held captive within them, imprisoned and restrained in those celestial states that are above.

**¶3:** The second domain is the eight natural and infernal states that lie below: the four that are of mixed quality, and the four states of pure falsity from evil. This second domain extends from the conscious natural mind, in which mankind dwells and walks, downward into the nether regions.

**¶4:** The third domain is the boundaries and the containing doctrinal forms that surround the spiritual worlds. These are the four elevated states of good and the three containing forms of doctrine, together with all that is held within them, and the power of evil that is confined within their structures, and the spiritual forces that exercise mastery over them.

**¶5:** The fourth domain is the cycle of knowledges that was arranged with great providential care, as it is ordered in a [GAP-1: manifold spiritual arrangement encompassing] many [GAP-2: governing principles and correspondences]; the arrangement proceeding from the Divine Good that gives life, [GAP-3: REVIEW — and from the Divine Truth that brings forth] all living states.

**¶6:** Its [GAP-4: structure was fashioned with] very great [GAP-5: providential precision] and care, because of the immense and merciless evils and the titanic forms of hereditary falsity [GAP-6: REVIEW — that are] bound within it, they being suspended from the cycle itself. Thus all the firstborn and chief evils, and the leaders among all the ruling falsities — those that had existed distributed throughout the three other domains — were gathered up. They were collected together, seized, bound, and assigned upon this cycle of knowledges. Each was apportioned out of those three domains. They were distributed, intertwined, and counterbalanced against their counterparts of equal force.

**¶7:** Nevertheless, for its part, the cycle of knowledges is equal in strength to those hostile powers that are bound upon it. Indeed, they were suspended upon the turning cycle because of the ferocity of their evil, so that, through the influx of spiritual life and the perpetual change of state in which they are carried round, they cannot comprehend or fix their awareness upon the condition in which they are held. For if they had been confined in the celestial states, those heavenly degrees would not have had the strength to bear them. Again, if they had been assigned upon the natural states, upon the fixed lower foundations, those also would not have had the strength to support them. Rather, they were suspended from the revolving cycle of knowledges, so that the wisdom and the truth that ascend from lower states can be received and transmitted to the celestial states above them. Conversely, whatever descends from above — whether states devoid of charity or states of consuming self-love — the revolving cycle also receives it and distributes it upon the whole of the natural mind, upon all perception.

**¶8:** Behold, the spiritual order of the cycle is in this form. For the evil powers that are intertwined upon the cycle are like this: a ruling love governing its entire domain by the mighty combined force of all the governing principles of that domain; and with all the truths arrayed for combat and defense that are gathered to it; and also with the whole mass of spiritual possessions belonging to that domain; and the alluring beauty of the affections that are gathered to it; together with [GAP-7: all the] possessions [GAP-8: of natural good] and those natural affections [GAP-9: and desires] that have been distributed among its attendant states. Yet, if you inquire about that ruling love, it is matched in power with all its attendant states. Its attendant states, for their part, are matched against the whole domain. Judgment goes forth from it — vindication and condemnation — to its entire domain, by its wisdom, its skill, and its strength.

**¶9:** Now, just as this ruling love is matched against the measure of its entire domain by its wisdom, skill, and strength, so also is it for the evil powers that are bound upon the cycle of knowledges as compared to the dominion and the spiritual forces that exist throughout the whole zone of creation. As the ruling love stands toward its attendant states, so too all that exists is gathered to the cycle — to seven governing principles, to twelve fundamental states of the complete spiritual round. As all systems of doctrine are gathered to the ruling love, again they gather to the governing principles of the spiritual universe. All that is done in the spiritual world above and below — the conflicts and the disorders and the captivities and the deprivations and the concupiscences and the possessions — all these increase and diminish through these governing principles. They are the movers of the whole created order.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The wheel of the stars is a great mighty thing! Also, it is one among the four great things; since the whole ruling-power is assigned to four parts.
The first part is the powers who occur in the ten firmaments that exist above the wheel, and the ruling-power that is bound in them, as it is imprisoned within them in the heavens that are above.

The second part is the eight earths that are below; the four that are composite, and the four places of darkness. The second part extends from this earth, upon which mankind walks, towards the underside.

The third part is the walls and the vessels that surround the worlds. They are the four mountains and the three vessels; with what is in them, and the ruling-power that is trapped within them, and the powers who are masters over them.

The fourth part is the sphere of the stars that is appointed with great diligence, as it is ordered in a [great arrangement with]any [ordinances]; that of the Father of Life, [and that of the Mother of] the living.

Its [ordering was made with] very [great care] with diligence, because of the great and cruel powers, and the titanic figures, [who are bound] in it; they being suspended from it. So, all the first-born and the leaders of all the rulers, they who were existing in the three parts, these were garnered. They were collected together, seized, bound and assigned on this wheel. Each was apportioned by these three parts. They were distributed, entwined, and weighted against their companions of the same size.

Still, for its part, the wheel is equal to them in its strength; the powers of the enmity who are bound on it. Indeed, they were suspended on the circling wheel because of their cruelty; so that, due to the wind and the motion in which they go round, they comprehend not the place wherein they are set. For if they had been bound in the heavens, the heavens would not have had the strength to support them. Again, if they had been assigned on the earths, on the fixtures that are below, they also would not have had the strength to support them. Rather, they were suspended from the wheel of the circling stars; so that the power and the light that should come up from below can be received, and given to the heavenly ones above them. Conversely, whatever will fall from above, whether cold or hot, the wheel of the sphere will also take it and cast it out upon the entire earth, upon all the wood.

Behold, the ordinance of the wheel is in this form. For the powers who are entwined on the wheel are like this: a king mastering his kingdom by this mighty legionary force of all the leaders of the kingdom; and with all the armour of the soldiery that is collected together for him; and also with the mass of the property of the kingdom; and the beautiful lustful aspect of the women who are collected together for him; together with [all the] property [of the land] and those cattle [and beasts] that have been distributed about among his retinue. Yet, if you ask about that king, he is matched with all his retinue. His retinue, for its part, is matched against his entire kingdom. Judgement shall come forth from him, vindication and condemnation, to his entire kingdom; by his wisdom, skill and strength.

Now, just as for this king, who is matched against the measure of his entire kingdom by his wisdom, skill and strength; so also is it for the powers who are bound on the sphere as compared to the ruling-power, and the powers who exist in the entire zone. Like the king towards his retinue; so too is it that this totality is gathered to the sphere, to seven leaders, to twelve signs of the zodiac. As all the cities are gathered to the king, again they gather to the leaders of the universe. All that is done in the universe above and below: the battles and the disorders and the captivity and the hunger and the lust and the property; so shall they increase and diminish through these leaders. They are the motivaters of the whole created order.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading indicates "manifold spiritual arrangement encompassing many governing principles"; in the Kephalaia's natural register, this becomes "great arrangement with many," describing the sphere's comprehensive ordering by divine design.

The spiritual reading says "governing principles and correspondences"; in the Kephalaia's vocabulary, "ordinances" is the natural-plane equivalent for governing principles (cf. ¶8: "the ordinance of the wheel"), and the word appears elsewhere in the chapter.

fills.explanation: The editor's fill correctly identifies the standard Manichaean pairing: the Father of Life and the Mother of the Living — corresponding to Divine Good (Father) and Divine Truth (Mother) in Swedenborg's system, confirmed by the spiritual reading's "Divine Truth that brings forth."

The spiritual reading says "structure was fashioned with very great providential precision"; in Kephalaia register, "ordering was made with" naturally precedes "very great care, with diligence" and describes the fashioning of the sphere's arrangement.

The spiritual reading indicates "providential precision" for this position; "great care" translates that spiritual concept into the Kephalaia's natural register, yielding "very great care, with diligence" — the emphatic repetition being characteristic of Kephalaia style.

The spiritual reading says "that are bound within it"; correcting the editor's "who are" to "who are bound" adds the binding language that the spiritual reading requires and that parallels the chapter's pervasive theme of evil powers being seized, bound, and assigned upon the wheel.

The spiritual reading says "all the possessions"; "all the" is the standard Kephalaia quantifier introducing collective property in an enumeration, matching the pattern of "all the armour," "all the leaders" seen throughout the passage.

The spiritual reading says "of natural good"; in Swedenborg's correspondences, "the land/earth" = the natural mind, so "property of the land" is the natural-plane equivalent of "possessions of natural good," distinguishing agricultural/landed wealth from the kingdom's general property mentioned earlier.

The spiritual reading says "and desires"; in Swedenborg's correspondences, cattle = good natural affections while beasts = desires from the will, making "cattle and beasts" the natural-plane pair that corresponds to "natural affections and desires."
